text:
Samir: Heads-up: SentryEdge (hardware partner) emailed a request: devices will emit hourly metering exports and may replay up to 5 days. They want entitlements auto-applied for any replay within 5d. Need quick call on policy + dedupe keys.

PartnerBot: schema posted: /partners/sentryedge/usage_v1.json and sample payload uploaded to partner bucket.

Grace: finance: default auto-credit window should be 24h. ingest visibility can be longer, but automatic money moves beyond 24h are risky.

Hank: eng: we can dedupe if partner supplies monotonic batch_id per device and a `replay_id` or `batch_signature`. require signed JWT/HMAC. unique index on (partner_id,batch_id,replay_id) would make duplicates a no-op.

Mira: support: Console needs fields: batch_id, replay_id, signed_at, ledger_state, auto_credit_flag. also canned KB text explaining how replayed usage is handled.

Samir: compromise proposal: accept ingest up to 5d; auto-credit up to 72h if partner provides monotonic batch_id + signed JWT; otherwise auto-credit only within 24h. beyond 72h ingest for visibility and flag for manual review.

Hank: implementation notes: require header X-Partner-Signature HMAC, verify before enqueue; persist (partner, device, batch_id, replay_id) as unique combination; tombstone endpoint for voids within ingest window; when a replay arrives: if unique conflict -> ignore; else if signed_at >= now-72h and partner in whitelist -> apply credit; else if signed_at >= now-24h -> apply credit; else ingest with ledger_state=review_required.

Grace: finance will accept 72h pilot for enterprise partners if we add caps and rollback triggers. need daily telemetry on replay volume and a guardrail (e.g., pause pilot if replays >0.25% of daily revenue).

PartnerBot: sample payload from SentryEdge: ```{ "partner":"sentryedge","device":"SE-900","batch_id":"b-20260319-09","replay_id":"rpt_se_001","start":"2026-03-19T09:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-19T10:00:00Z","units":512,"signed_at":"2026-03-19T10:15:00Z","signature":"hmac_sha256=..." }``` 

Mira: I'll draft KB blurb: "We accept backfilled usage for visibility up to 5 days. Automatic credits are applied for data reported within 24 hours by default. Enterprise partners that provide monotonic batch IDs and signed manifests may be eligible for a 72-hour auto-credit pilot. Reports older than 72 hours are reviewed manually."

Samir: owners: Hank (eng) for idempotency + signature verification, Grace (finance) for pilot terms & caps, Mira (support) for KB + Console, Samir (partnerships) to negotiate. I'll tell SentryEdge the hybrid plan and request their monotonic batch_id rollout timeline.

CI Bot: queued replay-sim job (#SE-7210) against s3://sentryedge-tests/replay-sample-20260320.tar.gz. ETA ~90m.

Hank: I'll add a small feature flag to toggle auto-credit per-partner and a migration to add the unique index. estimate 2 dev days + 1 QA day.

Grace: prepping P&L stub for pilot, will include rollback thresholds.

PartnerBot: SentryEdge PM: "We can emit monotonic batch_id and replay_id. We'll join the pilot for 72h auto-credit once you provide the acceptance tests."

Samir: perfect. follow-ups in #PRT-7210 and ticket SE-99. closing thread unless blockers. :white_check_mark:
